# Replace the side brush

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Replace the side brush](../img/underside_600_900--side_brush.svg)

**What it does**

A worn side brush no longer reaches into edges and corners.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over.
2. Undo the screw, or pull the old brush off its shaft.
3. Push the new brush onto the shaft and fasten it.
4. Mark the side brush as replaced.

> **Note** Keep the screw: a brush that sits loose falls off during cleaning.

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j · Prime robots and other models

## Roomba s series

![Replace the corner brush](../img/underside_s--side_brush.svg)

**What it does**

A worn corner brush no longer reaches into corners.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over.
2. Undo the screw and take the old corner brush off.
3. Put the new corner brush on the peg and tighten the screw.
4. Report the corner brush as replaced.

> **Note** Keep the screw: a brush that sits loose falls off during cleaning.
